operating_notes.text: Bank reported 290 fraud cases involving ₹2,274.46 Cr in FY26, with outstanding balance of ₹2,004.04 Cr fully provided.
Bank holds ₹7,821.17 Cr provision covering 100% of IBC accounts outstanding as on March 31, 2026.
Bank raised ₹3,000 Cr of Infra Bonds in FY26 and called ₹2,705 Cr of Basel III Tier-I and Tier-II bonds.
FY26 CRAR 18.10% and CET-1 15.69%, up 71 bps YoY.
Renewable energy sector sanctions ₹33,572 Cr and Union Green Vehicle sanctions ₹2,084 Cr as on 31.03.2026.
PMJDY accounts 3.40 Cr with balance ₹15,964 Cr as on 31.03.2026, against 3.21 Cr and ₹13,266 Cr a year earlier.
Bank created an additional general provision of ₹700 crores in Q4 FY26.
Bank clarified that media reports on deposit variations were based on an unverified letter and confirmed average deposits for April 2026 exceeded Q4 FY26 average.
Bank invested an additional ₹22.64 Cr in JV ASREC (I) Ltd., lifting its stake to 27.30% from 26.02%.
Corporate book has more than ₹1,00,000 Cr sanctioned but not disbursed, and the bank says it underwrote ₹60,000-70,000 Cr of corporate loans in the last eight-nine months.
Average CASA was about ₹24,000 Cr and retail term deposits about ₹17,000 Cr in Q1FY27, a combined ₹41,000 Cr.
Bulk deposits fell to about 19% of total deposits from about 27%, and LCR averaged 121% against a board-approved 107% and RBI threshold of 100%.
